scripts.supabase:studio: npx supabase start && echo "Opening Studio at http://localhost:54323"
scripts.db:setup: npm run supabase:start && timeout /t 5 /nobreak && npm run supabase:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.cloud:staging:push: npx supabase link --project-ref $STAGING_PROJECT_REF && npx supabase db push
scripts.cloud:production:push: npx supabase link --project-ref $PRODUCTION_PROJECT_REF && npx supabase db push
